name: Punch Machine Championship

deploy.title: Punch Machine Championship
deploy.description: A standalone synchronized arcade punching competition with queue, leaderboard and cheering crowd.

listingDescription: An arcade punch machine on a sky island above the clouds. Hold to charge, release on the gold target, and take your turn in front of the crowd.

event.name: Punch Machine Championship
event.announceOnEnter: Enter the queue. On your turn, click and hold the bag, then release when full power crosses the gold timing target.

speakeasy.arrivalNote: Voice here is proximity-based — stand close to be heard, step outside to leave the conversation.
